verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a paid SaaS research service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an API, and probes of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The only downloadable item cited is a set of sample reports, which is not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
